ads.headline: Nature's Answer To Gum Care.
ads.signType: a huge roadside BILLBOARD beside a busy city highway, shot from the road with traffic below and sky behind
ads.brief: Bright daylight, realistic highway with cars, the billboard dominant and crystal sharp, green botanical accent. Small LACALUT HERBAL tube + mouthwash bottle lockup in the billboard's bottom corner.
ads.label: HERBAL SIGN S1 - Billboard

ads.headline: WARNING: Your Gums Weren't Built For Harsh Chemicals.
ads.signType: a weathered yellow-and-black INDUSTRIAL WARNING / caution metal sign, distressed with rust and scratches, bolted to a wall
ads.brief: The word WARNING huge across the top in heavy black caps on yellow, the rest of the message below in bold black. Gritty realistic metal texture. Small LACALUT HERBAL tube + mouthwash bottle at the bottom of the sign.
ads.label: HERBAL SIGN S2 - Warning Sign

ads.headline: Swap Harsh For Herbal. Every Morning.
ads.signType: a bright yellow POST-IT NOTE stuck on a bathroom mirror, handwritten in marker
ads.brief: Real bathroom mirror with soft reflection, morning light, the post-it in sharp focus with bold handwritten marker text. LACALUT HERBAL tube + the GREEN herbal mouthwash bottle (herbal green packaging, NOT the red Aktiv bottle) sitting small on the vanity.
ads.label: HERBAL SIGN S3 - Post-it on Mirror

ads.headline: German Herbal Gum Care Since 1925.
ads.signType: a push NOTIFICATION banner popping up at the top of a phone lock screen, bold notification title text
ads.brief: Realistic phone lock screen held in hand, time and battery at top, the LACALUT notification banner bold and legible. A small LACALUT HERBAL tube + mouthwash bottle visible on a surface behind the phone.
ads.label: HERBAL SIGN S4 - Phone Notification

ads.headline: 9 Herbs. Firm Gums.
ads.signType: bold lettering TATTOOED across the upper BACK of a person photographed from behind in a natural candid setting
ads.brief: Candid real photo from behind, natural skin and lighting, the tattoo text large, crisp and easy to read. LACALUT HERBAL tube + mouthwash bottle resting small on a bench in the background.
ads.label: HERBAL SIGN S5 - Back Tattoo

ads.headline: Herbal Gum Care.
ads.signType: a few words written across the FOREHEAD of a person, candid close-up portrait in a real everyday setting
ads.brief: Candid close-up of a believable everyday Australian, slight smile, the forehead text bold and clearly legible. Hold the message very short so it fits large across the forehead. If a mouthwash bottle appears, it is the GREEN herbal mouthwash (herbal green packaging, NOT the red Aktiv bottle).
ads.label: HERBAL SIGN S6 - Forehead
